messages:
alex: Quick check — deciding between a lightweight L7 adapter (Envoy filter/shim) vs a broker service for our internal inference API. Key constraints: per-tenant quotas, token-level billing, <200ms p95 for short prompts. Opinions?

emily: +1 for adapter if we can keep logic simple. lower network hops -> better tail latency. but adapters struggle when quota logic gets stateful or involves cross-tenant aggregation.

jamal: proto-first gRPC internally gives us typed payloads & cheaper wire. browser clients still want REST/JSON though. gateway can transcode, but watch latency.

sasha: Telemetry is the real blocker for adapter — we must propagate tenant_id, model_id, prompt_hash, and token counts to tracing & cost pipeline. If adapter can't insert those reliably before the runtime, we'll lose attribution.

alex: Good point on telemetry. Also worried about backpressure: broker can centralize rate limiting and shedding; adapter would need local leaky-buckets and a control-plane fallback. Tradeoffs?

emily: We could have adapter enforce fast-path per-tenant token limits (local cache) and consult control-plane for heavier policies. Example stub: ```yaml
envoy_filters:
  - name: token-quota
    typed_config: ...
```
Small and fast.

jamal: Proto example for internal surface: ```proto
message GenReq {
  string tenant = 1;
  string model = 2;
  string prompt = 3;
  bool stream = 4;
}
```
Then gateway does JSON <-> proto for external.

deploy-bot: Canary: adapter-shim v0.1 rolled to staging (10% traffic) — /ops/adapter-monitor shows no RTT spike. :rocket:

sasha: Proposal I think we can agree on: 1) proto-first internal gRPC surface, 2) L7 adapter for latency-sensitive fast-path with local quotas + header propagation, 3) control-plane broker for complex policies, aggregation and quota reconciliation, 4) gateway transcode for REST external clients. Start with perf harness to measure extra hop vs adapter-only.

alex: sgtm. I'll draft a short RFC and attach perf test plan. Action items: emily — prototype envoy filter for header propagation; jamal — sketch proto/IDL and gateway transcode; sasha — telemetry schema for token attribution. Back in a week. :thumbsup:
